sloka: तं प्रहस्याब्रवीद्द्रक्ष इक्ष्वाकुं पृथिवीपतिम् ।किमिदानीं फलं प्राप्तं त्वया मां प्रति युद्ध्यता ।। ७.१९.२४ ॥
transliteration: taṁ prahasyābravīddrakṣa ikṣvākuṁ pṛthivīpatim ।kimidānīṁ phalaṁ prāptaṁ tvayā māṁ prati yuddhyatā ।। 7.19.24 ॥

translations.english: That king, fallen on the ground with trembling and bewildered limbs, was greatly trembling, just like a Sala tree struck down by a thunderbolt in the forest.
